result.note: Draft fuel economy norms are a concrete release. Tested the 2031-32 fleet target and the compliance price, avoiding outcomes that are only proposed.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the draft fuel economy norms for carmakers released in July 2026:
items: They cut fleet carbon dioxide targets to 78.90 grams per kilometre by 2031-32.
They would let carmakers buy compliance at INR 25,000 per gram of carbon dioxide.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the draft prices compliance at INR 2,500 (USD 26) per gram of carbon dioxide, not INR 25,000. The draft norms are expected to steer the industry towards hybrids.
questions.source: Draft fuel economy norms would let carmakers buy compliance at INR 2,500 (USD 26) per gram of carbon dioxide, cutting fleet targets to 78.90 grams per kilometre by 2031-32 and steering the industry towards hybrids.
